sacred-thread-barrier.placement: zone (anchor = zone centre on the ground)
sacred-thread-barrier.description: SACRED THREAD BARRIER ground ward VFX. Camera: classic elevated three-quarter top-down MMORPG view looking straight north, NOT isometric. The ward is an AXIS-ALIGNED RECTANGLE lying flat on the ground: its FRONT edge is a perfectly HORIZONTAL straight line along the bottom, its BACK edge is a perfectly HORIZONTAL straight line near the top, the left and right edges are nearly vertical lines, like a flat rectangle seen from above at an angle, wider than tall. It is NOT rotated, NOT a diamond, NOT a rhombus, no corner points at the top or bottom centre. Four short carved antique-bronze ritual stakes stand upright at the four corners (two at the bottom left and right, two at the top left and right). A single taut cream-white sacred cotton thread runs low between the stakes along the four sides, small woven stepped knots and tiny tassels tied along it, faint antique-gold glow along the thread, a few small gold motes rising. The interior is EMPTY and fully transparent, no floor, no fill. Original fictional ornament only, no readable script, no religious symbols. Weathered antique gold, bronze, cream thread palette, crisp deliberate pixel clusters, transparent background, at least 10 pixels of empty margin on every side, no character, no text.
sacred-thread-barrier.action: The sacred thread draws itself around the rectangle starting from the front-left stake, running along each side until the boundary closes, the woven knots light up one by one in antique gold, a gentle gold shimmer pulses along the thread, then it settles into a calm steady faint glow. The interior stays empty and transparent, the boundary stays flat on the ground, same palette, transparent background.

prai-whispering-curse.description: PRAI WHISPERING CURSE spell VFX for a classic elevated three-quarter MMORPG view: thin dark smoky prai spirit wisps in muted dark crimson and deep violet-black curl and spiral upward around an EMPTY human-sized central space, two or three faint pale translucent whispering ghost mouths and hollow eyes half-formed inside the wisps, tiny dark crimson stepped knot seals and frayed crimson thread fragments drifting in the smoke, small dim ember sparks. The centre is open and transparent so a character stays readable. Eerie and restrained, not gore, no skull icons, no Western runes, no pentagram, no readable script. Muted dark crimson, deep violet-black, dim bone-white highlights palette, crisp pixel clusters, transparent background, at least 8 pixels of empty margin on every side, no character, no floor, no text.
prai-whispering-curse.action: Whispering prai wisps slither in from the sides and coil upward around the empty centre, the faint ghost mouths open as if whispering then dissolve, the crimson knot seals tighten into the smoke, then the wisps thin out into a few slow drifting dark embers. Keep the centre empty, same palette, transparent background.

sacred-thread-barrier-v2.description: SACRED THREAD WARD grand ground magic circle VFX, lying completely FLAT on the ground, seen from a classic elevated three-quarter MMORPG camera so the circle is a wide horizontal ELLIPSE (about twice as wide as tall), centred, with transparent margins. Original Thai occult yantra design: several concentric rings of antique gold light, between them bands of tiny original fictional stepped glyph marks (not real script), an outer ring made of twisted cream-white sacred cotton thread with woven knots at eight evenly spaced points, nested stepped square seals and lotus-petal-like pointed arches arranged around the centre, fine radiating gold lines, tall licking tongues of mystical VIOLET-PURPLE spirit fire burning around the outer ring, rolling dark violet smoke curling outward low along the ground beyond the rim, purple embers and gold motes rising from the rings, a few small jade spirit sparks. Rich, intricate and majestic, glowing but crisp, the very centre left calm and darker so a character standing on it stays readable. No pentagram, no hexagram, no European runes, no Western magic circle, no zodiac, no religious symbols, no sci-fi hologram, no vertical portal, no floor texture, no character, no text. Antique gold, bronze, cream thread, glowing violet-purple fire and dark violet smoke, small jade accents, dramatic and majestic, crisp deliberate pixel clusters, transparent background.
sacred-thread-barrier-v2.action: The grand ward ignites from the centre outward: the inner seal flashes in antique gold, the concentric rings draw themselves one after another, the glyph bands light up while slowly rotating in opposite directions, violet-purple spirit flames burst up around the outer ring and flicker, dark violet smoke rolls outward along the ground, the sacred-thread ring tightens and its knots flare, purple embers and gold motes rise, then it settles into a steady majestic burning glow. Stay flat on the ground as an ellipse, flames rise from the rim, same palette, transparent background.

terrorize-howl.description: TERRORIZE HOWL spell VFX for a classic elevated three-quarter fantasy RPG view: a powerful spirit SOUND WAVE spreading outward from an empty centre, lying flat on the ground as a wide horizontal ELLIPSE (about twice as wide as tall). Three separate thin jagged crimson-red ripple rings with gaps between them. Flying outward between the rings: ethereal translucent Thai prai spirit maidens in a folklore fantasy style, pale violet-white glowing figures with very LONG flowing black-violet hair streaming behind them, sorrowful wailing expressions, arms reaching outward, lower bodies trailing into long wisps of smoke (not bedsheet ghosts, not round cartoon ghosts). Tall violet-purple spirit flames rising along the outer ring, dark violet mist rolling outward low along the ground, crimson embers and small purple sparks. The very centre is an empty calm space. Eerie, dramatic and grand fantasy magic, no blood, no skulls, no pentagram, no Western runes, no readable script, no floor texture, no text. Crimson red, deep purple, violet fire, dark violet mist, pale violet spirit glow, black-violet hair, crisp deliberate pixel clusters, transparent background, at least 8 pixels of empty margin on every side.
terrorize-howl.action: The spirit wave spreads from the centre: the first crimson ripple ring expands outward, then the second and third follow, the long-haired prai spirit maidens wail and glide outward with the waves, their long hair flowing behind them, and fade into mist at the rim, violet flames flare up around the outer ring and mist rolls outward along the ground, embers drift, then the waves fade and only drifting mist and a few embers remain. Stay flat on the ground as an ellipse, centre stays empty, same palette, transparent background.
